value.rationale: The generalized Case M family is a natural two-parameter extension of a classical minimal chaotic flow with documented periodic and chaotic regions. The theorem gives a coefficient-sign obstruction to all non-equilibrium compact recurrence, exact stationary mean/variance geometry, forced sign/slab excursions, and a universal strict period floor. These are global structural constraints rather than routine numerical data or an arbitrary parameter slice.
